title: Google Local Services Ads Reporting Tool (2026 Guide)

facts.fact: Google Local Services Ads use a pay-per-lead model, with businesses charged $5–$150 per qualified lead depending on service category and market competition.
facts.quote: Unlike traditional Google Ads, Local Services Ads operate on a pay-per-lead model where you are charged $5–$150 per qualified lead depending on your service category and market competition.

facts.fact: The page cites BrightLocal research stating that 35% of Local Services leads never convert to actual customers.
facts.quote: Research from BrightLocal shows that 35% of Local Services leads never convert to actual customers due to poor qualification, pricing mismatches, or scheduling conflicts.

facts.fact: The page states that contractors without proper tracking can spend $2,000–$8,000 monthly on LSA leads that generate zero revenue.
facts.quote: Without proper tracking, contractors spend $2,000–$8,000 monthly on LSA leads that generate zero revenue.

facts.fact: The page says optimization opportunities from tracking the 15 KPIs can be worth $500–$3,000 monthly in wasted ad spend.
facts.quote: Track these 15 KPIs to identify optimization opportunities worth $500–$3,000 monthly in wasted ad spend.

facts.fact: Google My Business Insights is listed as free, with a setup time of 5 minutes, in the page's comparison table.
facts.quote: | Google My Business Insights | 5 minutes | Free | Basic lead tracking |

facts.fact: Ryze AI is listed in the comparison table with a 10-minute setup time and a free trial.
facts.quote: | Ryze AI | 10 minutes | Free trial | Automated optimization |

facts.fact: CallRail is listed at $30–$150 per month, with a 20-minute setup time, in the page's comparison table.
facts.quote: | CallRail | 20 minutes | $30–$150/month | Call tracking specialists |

facts.fact: Looker Studio is listed as free with a 45-minute setup time in the page's comparison table.
facts.quote: | Looker Studio | 45 minutes | Free | Custom dashboards |

facts.fact: Reporting Ninja is listed at $39–$199 per month, with a 30-minute setup time, in the page's comparison table.
facts.quote: | Reporting Ninja | 30 minutes | $39–$199/month | Agency-level reporting |

facts.fact: Ryze AI states that it tracks 18 conversion metrics including call duration, message response rate, and booking completion percentage.
facts.quote: It tracks 18 conversion metrics including call duration, message response rate, and booking completion percentage.

facts.fact: Ryze AI states that its clients see an average 45% improvement in lead-to-customer conversion within 4 weeks (vendor-reported figure).
facts.quote: Ryze AI clients see an average 45% improvement in lead-to-customer conversion within 4 weeks.

facts.fact: The page states industry data shows phone leads convert at 18–25%, while message leads convert at 8–12%.
facts.quote: Industry data shows phone leads convert at 18–25% while message leads convert at 8–12%.

facts.fact: The page states emergency plumbing LSA leads cost $45–$120 while routine maintenance leads cost $8–$25.
facts.quote: Emergency plumbing leads cost $45–$120 while routine maintenance leads cost $8–$25.

facts.fact: The page cites Harvard Business Review research stating businesses responding within 5 minutes are 9x more likely to convert leads.
facts.quote: Harvard Business Review research shows that businesses responding within 5 minutes are 9x more likely to convert leads.

facts.fact: The page gives an industry benchmark that 60–70% of LSA leads should rate 3+ on a 1–5 quality scale.
facts.quote: Industry benchmark: 60–70% of LSA leads should rate 3+ on quality.

facts.fact: The page states HVAC contractors see 40% more leads on Monday–Wednesday.
facts.quote: HVAC contractors see 40% more leads on Monday–Wednesday, while landscapers peak on weekends.

facts.fact: The page says Google My Business Insights displays 30-day and 90-day performance windows.
facts.quote: The interface displays 30-day and 90-day performance windows with filters for lead type (calls vs. messages) and service categories.

facts.fact: The guide covers 5 reporting platforms for Google Local Services Ads and 15 metrics every local service business should track.
facts.quote: This guide covers 5 reporting platforms for Google Local Services Ads, 15 metrics every local service business should track, and step-by-step setup instructions for automated reporting.

facts.fact: Reporting Ninja generates weekly and monthly reports in PDF format.
facts.quote: The platform generates weekly and monthly reports in PDF format with white-label branding options for agencies managing multiple clients.

facts.fact: The page states Local Services Ads penalizes businesses with poor responsiveness by reducing profile visibility.
facts.quote: Local Services Ads penalizes businesses with poor responsiveness by reducing profile visibility.

facts.fact: The guide was published on 2026-04-03.
facts.quote: Published Time: 2026-04-03

facts.fact: The vendor's blog states that a healthy lead-to-estimate conversion rate for home services ranges from 25–40%.
facts.quote: Healthy benchmarks range from 25–40% for home services.

facts.fact: The vendor's blog states that industry averages for estimate-to-sale conversion range from 15–35% depending on service type.
facts.quote: Industry averages range from 15–35% depending on service type.

facts.fact: The vendor's blog states that contractors with estimate-to-sale conversion rates below 20% typically have pricing or trust issues that LSA optimization alone cannot solve.
facts.quote: Contractors with conversion rates below 20% typically have pricing or trust issues that LSA optimization alone cannot solve.

facts.fact: The vendor's blog gives an example in which a 30% lead-to-estimate rate multiplied by a 25% estimate-to-sale rate yields a 7.5% overall lead-to-sale conversion rate.
facts.quote: For example: 30% × 25% = 7.5% overall conversion rate.

facts.fact: The vendor's blog states that sustainable customer acquisition cost should be no more than 15–20% of average project value.
facts.quote: Sustainable CAC should be no more than 15–20% of your average project value.

facts.fact: The vendor's blog states that healthy return on ad spend for local services ranges from 3:1 to 8:1 depending on margins.
facts.quote: Healthy ROAS for local services ranges from 3:1 to 8:1 depending on margins.

facts.fact: The vendor's blog states that LSA customer lifetime value is tracked over 12–24 months.
facts.quote: Track the total revenue generated per LSA customer over 12–24 months.

facts.fact: The vendor's blog states that calls over 5 minutes convert at 35–50% rates, while calls under 60 seconds rarely convert.
facts.quote: Calls under 60 seconds rarely convert, while calls over 5 minutes convert at 35–50% rates.

facts.quote: Calls under 2 minutes rarely convert to customers.

facts.fact: The vendor's blog states that businesses generating reviews from fewer than 25% of customers pay 30–40% more per lead than those with active review generation.
facts.quote: Businesses that generate reviews from fewer than 25% of customers pay 30–40% more per lead than those with active review generation.

facts.quote: Local service sales cycles range from same-day to 60+ days depending on project complexity.

facts.quote: Manual LSA reporting takes 3–5 hours weekly for most local service businesses.
